as_told.title: Roger Morales as the grassy knoll shooter

plain: The shot that killed President John F. Kennedy in Dallas in 1963, it is claimed, came from the grassy knoll, a small slope beside the motorcade's route, and was fired by a man named David Morales. The lawyer and activist Dan Sheehan says so on two episodes with Michels, which would mean a team of shooters, not one man. In the second telling he gives the name as Roger Morales and calls him the team's "dead eye" marksman.
